findings.message: reads a likely secret source and opens a network connection in the same source file
findings.remediation: Keep secrets out of agent-visible output and require an allowlisted destination before egress.
findings.impact: A nearby secret source and network sink create a plausible credential-exposure path requiring data-flow review.
findings.attack_vector: Production code reads a non-environment secret source and opens a network connection within a bounded call-site window.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
